state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. Every band through the
configuration band `E0601`–`E0650` carries cards, and so does the first slice of the `E07xx` types
band, `E0700`–`E0731`. Every other code (`E0732` onward in `E07xx`, then `E08xx` and `E09xx`) is in
the test module's `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in declaration order, and
`every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holds the two together both ways. `nvs agent show E0201`
prints a code's card. Stage 5 is not started.

next.title: every diagnostic code carries its card

items.text: **Drain the list, one band slice per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the next slice starts at `E0732` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:3606` and takes about 30 codes a session (through about `E0762`). The list at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:5038` is the order. A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above each code yourself with one `sed -n` over the slice, and send one `Explore` search for the raise sites (mostly under `crates/nvs-types/src/`), returning `file.rs:NN  CONSTANT  message  help` per code and `NOT RAISED` for a code nothing raises. The search returns only the first raise site, so `grep -rn` the constants whose code has several sites before you write a card that names one case. Peek the raise sites whose help gives the fix syntax before you copy it. Write every card as one `bun nv splice --patch` (OLD `Code::new("E0732");`, NEW the `.card(…)` form with `\` line continuations), plus one block deleting the slice's codes from the list, then `rustfmt --edition 2024` the file to reflow it. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:5059` once the list is empty: it asserts `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` is empty, and then the list and its half of the other test can go.
